candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll /eljarastar with CPV filters (66xxxxxx financial, 30144200/30160000 card & terminal, 72xxxxxx payment integration); optionally subscribe the notice-watch e-mail service to a monitored mailbox.

negative_findings.description: No national aggregator of Hungarian municipal council agendas/minutes (képviselő-testületi előterjesztések, jegyzőkönyvek) was found. or.njt.hu aggregates only local DECREES (önkormányzati rendeletek), not agendas or minutes, and several municipalities state that minutes are inspectable at the mayor's office during office hours.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searched in Hungarian for council minutes on bank selection; results were individual municipal sites plus the decree register, no cross-municipality index.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The earliest and often the only signal for sub-threshold municipal account/POS deals lives in these documents; without a central index, collection must be per-buyer and will be expensive and incomplete.

coverage_gaps.description: Hospital and hospital-maintainer buyers (OKFŐ / Országos Kórházi Főigazgatóság and individual kórházak) were not mapped to concrete procurement disclosure URLs in this run.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated pass on OKFŐ and the 10 largest county hospitals: locate közérdekű adatok/közbeszerzés pages and their EKR ajánlatkérő names; check whether hospital banking is centralised.

coverage_gaps.description: Only Budapest-centred buyers (BKK, BKV, Fővárosi Vízművek, Semmelweis) were concretely identified; county seats and regional Volán/water/waste operators are unmapped.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Use CoRe/EKR buyer-name enumeration filtered on CPV 66xxxxxx and 30144200 to derive a ranked national buyer list, then attach each buyer's disclosure URL.

coverage_gaps.description: Purchases below Kbt. thresholds (small municipalities, single POS terminals, small e-payment integrations) are structurally invisible in gazette/TED.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Combine council-minutes crawling with EFER/ASP joining announcements and, where available, municipal 'beszerzési szabályzat' + contract lists; consider FOI (közérdekűadat-igénylés) for a sample.

coverage_gaps.description: CPV/keyword taxonomy for this cell has not been validated against real notice text (e.g. whether 'számlavezetés' notices use 66110000, 66600000 or services-other codes).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Sample 30 historic notices from the gazette and CoRe, extract their CPV codes and title phrasings, and freeze a validated query set in both hu and en.

coverage_gaps.description: English-language coverage of this cell is thin by nature: only TED carries EN text; municipal, hospital and utility disclosures are Hungarian-only.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Treat Hungarian as the primary collection language and use EN only for TED and cross-border supplier intelligence; budget for hu NLP/extraction.

brief: For non-financial Hungarian public buyers, the procurement trail is layered: EKR is where procedures actually run, the Közbeszerzési Értesítő is the national notice of record, CoRe holds the concluded contracts (and thus renewal windows), and TED covers only the largest above-threshold cases such as BKK's e-ticket programme. The high-volume, low-value end — small municipalities, hospitals and schools buying account services or a handful of POS terminals — largely escapes all four and surfaces instead in képviselő-testületi előterjesztések, per-buyer közérdekű adatok pages and annual közbeszerzési tervek, which are fragmented across thousands of Hungarian-only sites with no central index. Two structural forces must be tracked alongside the notices: the Treasury's decentralised municipal account-keeping (194/2025. Korm. rendelet, live since Oct 2025, free to municipalities) is shrinking the commercial municipal-account market, while EFER/SZEÜSZ centralises card and e-payment acceptance so that many bodies join a state rail instead of tendering acquiring. Commercial aggregators (KHF.hu, Tender-Értesítő) are worth a subscription as a completeness cross-check rather than as a primary feed.
